messages:
zara: ran a live onboarding with a customer using the node quickstart. first few requests worked during signup, after they added a card the same container started returning 402s on /v1/generate. console showed \"trial credits applied\" briefly. anyone seen this timing/race?

ben: can you paste the quickstart env + one failing request headers? need x-request-id and any billing headers.

zara: here9s the minimal repro from their container:
```
# env per README
export SAMPLE_API_KEY=sk-temp-abc
node quickstart/index.js
```
quickstart code reads process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY though. first call: 200 OK. subsequent calls after adding card: 402 Payment Required
headers: x-request-id:req_zz99, x-billing-state:verification_in_progress, x-cache-hit=true
body: {"error":"payment_required","message":"confirm payment method"}

claire: two distinct things we've been tracking: (1) onboarding issues a provisional service-account token while payment processor verifies card; (2) the console surfaces a temporary trial credit as \"applied\" before the processor callback completes. combined with our prefix cache the first request can be served fine then enforcement kicks in after callback.

ben: also the node-sdk v1.5.2 had a regression in retry-policy that will retry on some 4xx when paired with x-retry-policy: default. 402 should be terminal for non-idempotent endpoints like /v1/generate. that can mask the failure in the UI.

zara: customer workaround was to `redwood auth rotate-service-account` after payment cleared and restart the quickstart container; that immediately restored 200s. we'll add that to KB.

onboard-bot: created INF-7007: \"quickstart: provisional SA TTL + billing webhook delay -> intermittent 402s\" assigned to ben. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-7007

ben: proposed actions: (a) sdk hotfix to treat 402/403 as terminal for generate/completions (owner: ben, eta: 48h), (b) quickstarts: add a preflight /v1/billing_status check that warns if billing_state != active and suggests rotating token (owner: devex, eta: 1 week), (c) docs: standardize env var to REDWOOD_API_KEY and explicitly call out provisional token TTL + rotate step (owner: claire, eta: today).

claire: support playbook update: when customers report first-call success then 402, ask for x-request-id, org id, which env var they set, and whether they used the CLI or generated SA. immediate workaround is regen/rotate token and restart app.

ben: I'll also add a debug telemetry flag in the SDK to emit when a 4xx was retried so we can catch this in dogfood before broader rollout. low-risk opt-in for next release.

zara: will update the customer's ticket with the workaround and link to INF-7007. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
